name: Supper with Santa at Greenfield Village
when_note: December 3 to 6, 10 to 13, 17 to 23 and 26 to 28, 2026, 5 to 6 PM; wagon rides start at 4:30 PM
cost: Ticketed dining experience; book online or by phone, not sold at the gate
paras: Supper with Santa at Greenfield Village in Dearborn is a family dinner with a visit from Santa. It runs on 18 evenings in December 2026 from 5 to 6 PM, and horse-drawn wagon rides begin at 4:30 PM.

Families sit down to a hearty seasonal meal in a decorated historic setting. Tickets for special dining experiences are sold online and by phone, and they cannot be bought on site, so reserve before you go.
tip: Book ahead because tickets are not sold on site.

name: Holiday Nights in Greenfield Village
when_note: December 3, 6, 10, 13, 17, 21 to 23 and 26 to 28, 2026; doors open to the public at 6:30 PM and the event ends at 10 PM
cost: $39 to $48 for the public; youth ages 5 to 11 get 25% off and children 4 and under are free
paras: Holiday Nights turns Greenfield Village in Dearborn into a lantern-lit Christmas village on select evenings in December 2026. Doors open to the public at 6:30 PM and the night ends at 10 PM.

Rides are included, with a carousel, Model T rides, horse-drawn wagon rides with live music and free ice skating with skate rental. Families also see decorated homes and shops, carolers, cooking and artisan demonstrations, and a fireworks finale with a sing-along. Public tickets run $39 to $48, youth ages 5 to 11 save 25 percent, and children 4 and under are free.
tip: Buy tickets in advance because seasonal demand is high.

name: Golden Holiday Winter Lighting at Beacon Park
when_note: Daily from November 21, 2026 through January 18, 2027, 6 AM to 10 PM
paras: Beacon Park in downtown Detroit is lit with golden holiday lighting every day from November 21, 2026 through January 18, 2027. The park is open from 6 AM to 10 PM at 1901 Grand River Ave.
Families can walk through the lights for free, so it works well as a quick after-dinner stop or as part of a downtown Detroit holiday outing.
tip: Go after dark when the lighting looks best.

name: Holiday Lights at the Farm at Wolcott Mill Metropark
when_note: Fridays and Saturdays December 4, 5, 11, 12, 18 and 19, 2026, 6 to 9 PM
cost: $8 per person; a Metroparks vehicle entry permit is also required
paras: Holiday Lights at the Farm brings a Christmas light display to Wolcott Mill Metropark in Ray on six evenings in December 2026. It runs Fridays and Saturdays from 6 to 9 PM.
The cost is $8 per person, and a Metroparks vehicle entry permit is also required to drive into the park.
tip: Bring your Metroparks permit so entry goes quickly.

name: Midnight Madness Santa on Main Street
paras: Santa Claus visits Main Street in downtown Ann Arbor during Midnight Madness on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 7 to 9 PM. Kids of all ages can share wish lists and take a festive photo with him.
Midnight Madness also brings holiday sales, entertainment and community events downtown to kick off the season, so families can shop and visit Santa in one trip.
tip: Park early because downtown fills up on Midnight Madness.

name: Glenlore Trails Aurora with Santa Visits
address: 3860 Newton Rd., Commerce Charter Township, MI 48382
when_note: Thursdays through Sundays through December 27, 2026, 5 to 10 PM; Santa visits December 18, 19 and 20
cost: $25 for ages 13 and up; $15 for ages 4 to 12; free for children 3 and under
paras: Glenlore Trails Aurora is a lit holiday trail at Glenlore Trails in Commerce Township. It is open Thursdays through Sundays through December 27, 2026, from 5 to 10 PM.

Santa visits on December 18, 19 and 20, and families can enjoy kids crafts, face painting, hot cocoa and a cookie. Tickets are $25 for ages 13 and up and $15 for ages 4 to 12, and children 3 and under are free.
tip: Buy tickets online and dress for a long outdoor walk.

name: Holiday Extravaganza Parade and WinterFUN Festival in Pontiac
when_note: Saturday, December 5, 2026, 10 AM to 2 PM; parade at 11 AM
paras: Downtown Pontiac hosts its Holiday Extravaganza Parade and WinterFUN Festival on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 10 AM to 2 PM, with the parade at 11 AM.
The festival includes visits with Santa and Mrs. Claus, the Grinch and friends, horse-drawn wagon rides, ice carving demos, face painting, a petting farm, pony rides, treats and crafts.
tip: Arrive before 11 AM to find a spot along the parade route.

name: Clarkston Christmas Market at Depot Park
paras: The Clarkston Christmas Market fills Depot Park in the Village of Clarkston on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 4 to 8 PM.
Kids have free activities, and families can browse the market and enjoy the village at night.
tip: Dress warmly because the market is outdoors.

name: Innovation Hills Holiday Lights
address: 2800 W. Hamlin Rd., Rochester Hills, MI 48307
when_note: December 1, 2026 through January 10, 2027; 5 to 7 PM Monday to Thursday and 5 to 8 PM Friday to Sunday
cost: Free; a $1.50 per hour park fee is paid through ParkMobile
paras: Innovation Hills Park in Rochester Hills glows with a free holiday light display from December 1, 2026 through January 10, 2027. Hours are 5 to 7 PM Monday through Thursday and 5 to 8 PM Friday through Sunday.
Entry to the lights is free, and a park fee of $1.50 per hour is paid through ParkMobile. A Holiday Lights Kickoff on Friday, December 4 starts at 5 PM.
tip: Set up ParkMobile before you arrive.
